title: Wtf??
body:
There’s too much going on that I have to look for within the app so the times and days I book make sense on the wheel chart.
At first I thought the wheel graph, chart , whatever it is was cool with the different colours with each category, but I can’t figure it all out. And my adhd gets angry every time I put an appointment in.
Chat to a human opinion seems like what’s app, but no one has answered yet. I’m done with this.
author: Fin/s

title: Nope
body: Aggressively asks for money, refuses to function without giving up personal calendar data.

title: Need more for free version
body: Could we please get the repeat option for the free version? Otherwise I feel like this app requires too much time inputting tasks.
author: Cheerio bear

title: Super Effective!
body: This app has helped me profoundly with keeping on track and the team is lovely!
author: viparky

title: This is it. No need to keep looking.
body: This app truly has it all. The only issue I have is that I wish I had found it much sooner. As a student, finding ways to balance my time and visualize it all is so difficult. However, this app takes all the guess-work out of it. It syncs with my google and phone cals immediately, and is colour coded to your cal theme. Im seriously impressed and wish I knew this was a thing long ago.
author: Ahfjkgdf

title: Very helpful
body: I have ADHD and time blindness is one of my main struggles. It helps me to plan my day and be late less often.
author: alychoupi

title: Fantastic
body: This app has changed the calendar game! I haven’t double booked myself since I started using it and being able to see my day makes planning way easier. I can’t recommend it enough! I will say, I can’t speak for the free version as I loved the app so much when I first got it that I immediately got membership. On top of that, when I encountered a small issue, I reached out using the contact info provided and had the best customer service experience I’ve ever had! Thank you Weel 💕
author: Quizzical_Bonsai

title: Subscription too expensive
body: Used everyday until my sub ran out. If there was a cheaper lifetime plan I would buy it.
author: WhiteAmberlyn

title: Pricing is a joke
body: Although not necessary at all to purchase the subscription to use the app (as far as I can tell) the fact that it’s priced (CAD$) $10/m, $50/y, or $130/life is absurd. Asides from the prices, having a subscription model for an app like this is also a bit much.
author: YabaaDabaaDooo

title: Fantastic app!
body: Convenient interface, great Apple Watch complication and aesthetics. I never leave a review, but this app is special.
